summary: Implemented the desktop Seeker viewing-appointments surface for SEK-05. The feature consumes the implemented seeker viewing list, create, reschedule, and cancel contracts, preserves server ownership and optimistic-version rules, renders localized safe projections, and covers loading, empty, error, retry, permission, validation, conflict, success, and confirmation states.

Web source, tests, server, and Playwright configuration linted with zero warnings.

scopeNotes: No backend runtime behavior, database model, dependency, OpenAPI route, or Postman route was changed; the shared contracts change only exports the existing ViewingListData schema type for type-safe frontend consumption.
The apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx change is an authorized direct integration exception required to connect /seeker/viewings to the protected route shell.

The viewing contract does not expose availableActions. The UI therefore renders only actions supported by the implemented seeker routes and status rules; it does not infer or invent unsupported transitions.
The approved SEK-05 device scope is desktop only. Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese were verified with their repository direction rules.

The in-app browser connector could not initialize because its environment metadata lacked sandboxPolicy; the repository-configured Playwright desktop matrix was used for executable visual and accessibility assertions.
